reading.title: Describing garment construction
reading.text: In a design critique, Rami describes the garment's construction. A seam joins fabric pieces, a dart shapes cloth with a tapered sewn fold, and a pleat creates a defined fold. Gather is used here as a verb for drawing fabric into small folds. The hem finishes an edge. A collar surrounds the neck, a cuff finishes a sleeve end, and a sleeve covers the arm. The bodice is the upper part of a dress. A waistband lies around the waist. A zipper joins two rows of teeth, while a button passes through a buttonhole. A snap has two parts that press together; a hook and eye uses a hook and loop. Velcro is a trademark associated with hook-and-loop fastening. Rami names the feature before explaining how it affects the silhouette.

reading.title: Comparing fasteners and decoration
reading.text: Rami's accessory board separates fastening from decoration. A buckle secures a strap. Lace-up means fastened with threaded laces; a toggle passes through a loop. A drawstring tightens an opening, and a magnetic clasp closes with magnetic parts. Embroidery decorates cloth with stitches; beading attaches small beads, and a sequin is a small shiny decorative piece. Appliqué attaches fabric shapes to a larger surface. Fringe hangs in strands along an edge, a ruffle uses gathered fabric, and ribbon is a narrow strip. Piping gives an edge a raised finish. Smocking decorates gathered cloth with stitching. A monogram combines identifying letters; it is different from an abstract sewn pattern. Rami asks which detail needs refinement rather than assumes every decoration has the same function.

reading.title: Discussing a collection
reading.text: The critique compares design and production terms. Haute couture describes high-end made-to-measure fashion, with specific industry recognition in its formal French use. Prêt-à-porter means ready-to-wear. A collection groups related garments, and season identifies a design or selling period. A lookbook presents the range through images. A trend describes a direction in current fashion, while silhouette concerns a garment's overall outline. A colorway is one color combination for a design. A capsule is a small coordinated collection. Sustainable fashion concerns efforts to reduce environmental harm and improve social responsibility across a product's life cycle; it is not established by a green color or natural-looking fabric. Rami asks what evidence supports the claim and how the chosen material affects the design brief.
